_comment: Hand-transcribed from the kiosk's Eat & Drink pages (category 1311). The hours there are prose, bilingual, with inconsistent dash characters, meal-period labels, and day exceptions buried in sentences -- parsing them would silently produce WRONG opening hours, which is worse than none. English only. `to: "00:00"` means midnight and is treated as the following day. Menus live in menus.json, captured separately.

venues.name: Agora Restaurant
venues.description: Modern, minimal style serving breakfast, lunch and dinner. Full buffet with show cooking and a variety of local specialities. Occasional themed evening meals. Extensive wine selection.

venues.name: Ginger, Fusion Cuisine
venues.description: Fusion dining — a culinary journey of extraordinary flavours.
venues.hoursNote: Evenings, by reservation. The kiosk publishes no fixed hours.

venues.name: Mylos, Modern Greek Cuisine
venues.description: Greek cuisine with a modern twist, from the freshest locally sourced ingredients. One of the selected Aegean Cuisine Restaurants, awarded Greek Cuisine and Flag in Life 2023.
venues.hoursNote: Evenings, by reservation. The kiosk publishes no fixed hours.

venues.name: Blue Bay, Fine Dining Restaurant
venues.description: Fine dining at Atlantica Imperial Residences. Awarded the FNL Star 2023 and Flag in Life 2023 & 2024, ranking among the top 200 restaurants in Greece.
venues.hoursNote: Evenings, by reservation. The kiosk publishes no fixed hours.

venues.name: Blue Bay Breakfast
venues.description: Custom-made egg recipes, wellness juices, Nespresso Premium coffee and aromatic teas, freshly prepared each morning.

venues.name: Street Food Lab
venues.description: Freshly made cold and warm sandwiches, salads and more. Next to the Agora main restaurant.
venues.hoursNote: The kiosk publishes no fixed hours.

venues.name: The Lounge Bar
venues.description: Terrace views and drinks at any time of day. Occasionally live music in the evening.

venues.name: Helios Pool Bar
venues.description: Exotic cocktails, juices, alcoholic drinks, soft ice cream, coffee and tea by the pool.

venues.name: Sky Bar
venues.description: Soft and alcoholic drinks including cocktails, beers and wines, at the Imperial Residences.
venues.restriction: Red Carpet guests only until 18:00, open to all guests after

venues.name: The Cove Beach Bar
venues.description: Seaside setting with refreshing drinks, light bites and chilled music by the water.

venues.name: In Room Services
venues.description: Rooms have a mini bar and coffee & tea facilities. For all-inclusive guests the mini bar is replenished daily with 2 beers, 2 Pepsi, 1 7Up, 1 juice, water, nuts and crisps. Half board guests may request one at extra charge. Free water stations are available around the hotel.

themeNights._comment: Agora's dinner buffet theme, by weekday. Same shape as the daytime activities grid.

specialEvents.name: Taste Greece 2026 — Ettore Botrini
specialEvents.description: Corfiot onion pie, swordfish carpaccio, Pasta Mista and Bourdeto, drawing on Greek-Italian heritage.

specialEvents.name: Taste Greece 2026 — Alexandros Tsiotinis
specialEvents.description: Octopus, fresh fish, grouper fillet and beef cheek through refined techniques and contemporary interpretation.

info.title: Food Safety & Allergy Information
info.body: Tell any outlet about preferences, allergies or dietary requirements and they will make arrangements.

info.title: Early Breakfast
info.body: Book at reception one day ahead, before 18:00; delivered to your room that evening. Per person: strawberry & raspberry nut bar (0% sugar), rice rolls with cheese and olive oil (gluten free), cranberry and almond bar (gluten free), mixed nuts and dried fruits, sesame bar (0% sugar).

info.title: Snack Pack
info.body: For days out. Book one day ahead before 18:00 and collect next morning from the hostess in the main restaurant. Includes the early breakfast items plus a juice, water and fruit. €18.00 per pack for half board guests.

info.title: All-Inclusive Upgrade
info.body: Upgrade after arrival via reception. €65 per person per day for 3+ days, €70 per person per day for 1–2 days. Includes full board buffet, unlimited local and branded drinks 10:00–00:00, hot drinks, snacks 12:00–17:00, coffee break 15:00–17:00, one à la carte dinner per stay (reservation required), a picnic bag for days out, and a daily-replenished minibar. All-inclusive orders end at 00:00 and are strictly for personal use, with an allowance of 2 drinks per order.
